purpose: Canonical campaign-global ledger for every unresolved, deferred, later-phase-required, or cross-reviewer audit obligation. Narrative phase-report reminders do not replace this ledger.
sealingRules: At a Lite segment start, enumerate all obligations whose requiredPhase equals the active segment before substantive work proceeds.
Before a Lite milestone seal, every obligation due within that milestone must be reconciled.
A due obligation may close only as SATISFIED, NOT_APPLICABLE with evidence-bound reason, or SUPERSEDED with an explicit replacement obligation/evidence relationship.

BLOCKED_CARRIED requires a typed limitation/process-blocker record and an explicit permitted later requiredPhase; mandatory work may not be deferred merely for cost, inconvenience, missing effort, or agent preference.
An OPEN or IN_PROGRESS obligation due in the active milestone forbids the milestone seal.
New later-segment obligations must receive stable OBL-* IDs before the milestone report is sealed.
The Lite Milestone Report carried-forward table is a human-readable projection of this ledger, not an independent obligation store.
